method: Visio.InvisibleApp COM: select one glued connector on the page, Selection.Duplicate(), read the copy's cells, SaveAsEx, read the saved page XML. Source documents: viewers/visio/docs/evidence/reference-corpus/reference-corpus.vsdx (page connectors, stencil Dynamic connector, shape 4 glued Conn.A to Conn.B) and reference-flat.vsdx (page flat-glued-lines, drawn line shape 3 point-glued to Glue.A and Glue.B).

stencilDynamicConnector.copyEndPoints: unchanged (BeginX 2, BeginY 5, EndX 5, EndY 3.5); Duplicate applied no offset to a glued dynamic connector
stencilDynamicConnector.copyFormulas: BeginX..EndY keep _WALKGLUE(BegTrigger,EndTrigger,WalkPreference) and carry E=#VALUE! in the saved XML
stencilDynamicConnector.copyTriggers: BegTrigger and EndTrigger become _XFTRIGGER(Sheet.<copy id>!EventXFMod) with V=1

drawnLineWithPointGlue.copyEndPoints: offset by the page duplicate offset (0.33, -0.33 in) and held as plain values: BeginX V=2.33 and no formula

coreBehaviour: duplicate-shapes of a glued line writes no Connect rows, turns the end formulas into plain values shifted by the edit offset, and for a stencil connector rewrites the two triggers to the copy's own sheet. Copying a glued target shape leaves the connectors with the original.
